query:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS relation_name, c.oid::bigint AS relation_oid,
s.seq_scan::bigint, s.seq_tup_read::bigint, s.idx_scan::bigint, s.idx_tup_fetch::bigint,
s.n_tup_ins::bigint, s.n_tup_upd::bigint, s.n_tup_del::bigint, s.n_tup_hot_upd::bigint,
s.n_live_tup::bigint, s.n_dead_tup::bigint, s.n_mod_since_analyze::bigint,
s.n_ins_since_vacuum::bigint, s.vacuum_count::bigint, s.autovacuum_count::bigint,
s.analyze_count::bigint, s.autoanalyze_count::bigint, s.last_autovacuum::text,
s.last_autoanalyze::text, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint AS total_bytes,
c.reltuples::bigint AS planner_estimate
FROM pg_stat_all_tables s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.relid
JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_temp%'
AND n.nspname <> 'information_schema' ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname
privacy: catalog and aggregated statistics only; no private rows or SQL parameters
